title: fix(core): eliminate unsafe as any casts in live preview modules

reviews.body:
Reviewed PR #112.

This resubmission addresses the blockers from #110:

- CLA check is now passing.
- PR title now follows Conventional Commits: `fix(core): eliminate unsafe as any casts in live preview modules`.
- The previous duplicated committer / unsigned-CLA issue is gone; this PR contains a single committer.

Local validation performed in an isolated checkout:

```text
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json
pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core test -- live-preview --reporter=verbose
pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core test -- --runInBand
```

These checks passed.

Notes:

- `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core build` could not be completed locally because Rollup's macOS optional native package `@rollup/rollup-darwin-arm64` was missing in the local install, which is the known npm/pnpm optional-dependency environment issue and not a code failure from this PR.
- I reviewed the changed areas in `live-preview-table.ts`, `live-preview-diag.ts`, `live-preview.ts`, `live-preview-renderers.ts`, and the new regression tests. The unsafe `as any` usage is replaced with narrower project-local types / guards, and the added tests cover empty table cells plus inline HTML in table cells.

Conclusion: approved from code-review perspective.
